title: Shakshuka Middle Eastern Style Claypot
description: A delicious and spicy Middle Eastern dish made with shakshuka and eggs, cooked in a claypot.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat the zesty in a claypot over medium heat.
Add the shakshuka and stir to coat with the zesty.
Add the middle eastern spices and stir to combine.
Pour the eggs into the claypot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
